question: Use differentials to estimate $\sqrt[3]{64.3}$ correct to four decimal places.
explanation:
Function and increment
Let $y=x^{\frac{1}{3}}$. Choose $x=64$ and $dx=0.3$, since $64.3=64+0.3$.
Differential relation
$$dy=\frac{1}{3x^{\frac{2}{3}}}dx$$
Evaluation of the differential
Since $64^{\frac{1}{3}}=4$, we have $64^{\frac{2}{3}}=16$. Therefore,
$$dy=\frac{0.3}{3(16)}=\frac{0.3}{48}=0.00625$$
Approximate value
$$\sqrt[3]{64.3}\approx\sqrt[3]{64}+dy$$
$$\sqrt[3]{64.3}\approx4+0.00625$$
Conclusion
Thus, $\sqrt[3]{64.3}\approx4.0063$ correct to four decimal places.
